## Problem

What problem does this solve? What's awkward or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see? API sketches are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Package(s) affected

e.g. `@azt/events`, a new package, an example
